name: Baron AI - AI Visibility Audit (v2 - 3 engines + comments)

parameters.content:
## 🟢 READ ME FIRST — Setup Checklist

Do these 5 things after importing, in order:

**1. Create 4 credentials** (Settings → Credentials):
- `Anthropic API Key` → type **Header Auth** → Name: `x-api-key` → Value: your key from console.anthropic.com
- `Perplexity API Key` → type **Header Auth** → Name: `Authorization` → Value: `Bearer pplx-xxxx` (key from perplexity.ai/settings/api)
- `OpenAI API Key` → type **Header Auth** → Name: `Authorization` → Value: `Bearer sk-xxxx` (key from platform.openai.com)
- `Gmail account` → type **Gmail OAuth2**

**2. Re-select credentials** in these 6 nodes (they show a red ⚠ after import): Ask Claude, Ask Perplexity, Ask ChatGPT, Analyse Mentions, Generate HTML Report, Send Report.

**3. Edit your branding** → open the *Generate HTML Report* node and replace the contact placeholder text in the prompt with Baron AI's real email/phone/website.

**4. Activate the workflow** (toggle top-right).

**5. Get your form link** → open *Audit Request Form* node → copy the Production URL. That link is your audit intake — bookmark it.

💷 Cost per full audit: roughly £1–£2.50 in API fees across all 3 engines.

## 📋 Intake + Prompt Builder

**Audit Request Form** — no changes needed. Fill it per prospect/client. Business Name must match how they appear publicly online (this is what mention-detection looks for).

**Build Prompts** — generates up to 18 questions from the form. Things you can safely edit inside the code:
- The question templates (the 3 lines starting `prompts.push(...)`) — reword to match how real customers in your niche talk.
- `.slice(0, 4)` — max services used (raise = more prompts = higher cost).
- `.slice(0, 18)` — total prompt cap.

⚠️ Keep prompts identical month-to-month for the same client — that's what makes before/after scores comparable.

## 🤖 The 3 AI Engines

Each prompt is asked on **Claude** (with live web search), **Perplexity** (sonar — web-grounded by default), and **ChatGPT** (OpenAI Responses API with web search).

**Credentials:** each node uses its own Header Auth credential — see Read Me note.

**Batching:** requests run 2-at-a-time with a 1.5s gap to avoid rate limits. If you hit 429 errors, raise `batchInterval` to 3000 in the node's Options → Batching.

**Don't have all 3 API keys yet?** You can delete an engine branch (e.g. Ask ChatGPT + Normalise ChatGPT Answer), then open *Merge Answers* and reduce **Number of Inputs** from 3 → 2. The rest still works.

⚠️ Reality check: these APIs are close *proxies* for the consumer apps, not exact copies. For cold outreach, still manually screenshot 2–3 prompts in the real ChatGPT app — the screenshot is your hook, this workflow is the depth behind it.

## 🔍 Analysis + Scoring

**Analyse Mentions** — sends all 3 answers per question to Claude, which returns strict JSON: mentioned yes/no, list position, sentiment, competitors recommended instead, and the single best quote for your sales pitch. No changes needed.

**Aggregate Results** — computes:
- Visibility rate % per engine
- Top 8 competitors AI recommends instead (with counts)
- Question-by-question rows for the report table

✅ Before sending a report to a *paying* client, skim the question-by-question table — mention detection is very good but not perfect (oddly-phrased mentions occasionally slip through).

## 📄 Report + Delivery

**Generate HTML Report** — Claude writes a full client-ready HTML report (scorecard, competitor table, question-by-question results, next steps, disclaimer).

🖊 **EDIT THIS NODE:** in the prompt, replace `Baron AI Solutions LTD contact placeholder` with your real contact details. You can also tweak the colour palette instruction (currently dark navy + white) to match your brand.

**Send Report** — emails the HTML to whatever address was entered in the form. Use YOUR email for prospect audits (you forward it with your pitch); the client's email for monthly retainer reports.

💡 Upgrade later: pipe the HTML through Gotenberg (free, self-hosted) to attach a PDF instead — feels more like a £297 deliverable.

## 🔁 Retainer Version (later)

When clients are paying monthly:
1. Duplicate this workflow
2. Replace the Form Trigger with a **Schedule Trigger** (1st of month, 07:00 Europe/London)
3. Add a **Google Sheets** node reading a Clients sheet (same columns as the form)
4. Change every `$('Audit Request Form')` reference in the code/HTTP nodes to point at the Sheets data
5. Append each month's scores to a history tab → that history chart is why clients don't cancel.

⚠️ Sales language: never promise guaranteed AI placement. Sell measurement + systematic improvement. The report footer already includes the disclaimer.

parameters.formDescription: Enter the business details to run an AI visibility audit. The report is emailed automatically when finished.

nodes.name: Audit Request Form
nodes.notes: Your audit intake. Copy the Production URL after activating the workflow. Business Name must match how the business appears publicly online.

nodes.name: Build Prompts
nodes.notes: Generates up to 18 questions. Edit the templates inside — comments in the code show what's safe to change.

nodes.name: Ask Claude
nodes.notes: CREDENTIAL NEEDED: Header Auth → Name: x-api-key, Value: your Anthropic API key. Uses Claude with live web search (max 3 searches per question).

nodes.name: Ask Perplexity
nodes.notes: CREDENTIAL NEEDED: Header Auth → Name: Authorization, Value: 'Bearer pplx-xxxx'. Get a key at perplexity.ai/settings/api. Sonar model is web-grounded by default.

nodes.name: Ask ChatGPT
nodes.notes: CREDENTIAL NEEDED: Header Auth → Name: Authorization, Value: 'Bearer sk-xxxx'. Get a key at platform.openai.com. Uses the Responses API with web search — the closest API proxy to the ChatGPT app.

nodes.name: Merge Answers
nodes.notes: Combines the 3 engines' answers per question. If you remove an engine branch, reduce Number of Inputs here to match.

parameters.jsonBody:
={ "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6", "max_tokens": 900, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": {{ JSON.stringify('You are an AI-visibility analyst. Business being audited: ' + $('Audit Request Form').first().json['Business Name'] + ' in ' + $('Audit Request Form').first().json['Town / City'] + '. Known competitors: ' + ($('Audit Request Form').first().json['Known Competitors (comma separated)'] || 'none listed') + '.

Below are three AI-generated answers to the consumer question: ' + $json.prompt + '

--- ANSWER A (Claude) ---
' + ($json.claude_answer || '(no answer)') + '

--- ANSWER B (Perplexity) ---
' + ($json.perplexity_answer || '(no answer)') + '

--- ANSWER C (ChatGPT) ---
' + ($json.chatgpt_answer || '(no answer)') + '

Analyse whether the audited business is mentioned or recommended in each answer. Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences, no commentary, with this exact shape: {"claude": {"mentioned": true/false, "position": number or null, "sentiment": "positive" or "neutral" or "negative" or null, "competitors_mentioned": ["name", ...]}, "perplexity": {"mentioned": true/false, "position": number or null, "sentiment": "positive" or "neutral" or "negative" or null, "competitors_mentioned": ["name", ...]}, "chatgpt": {"mentioned": true/false, "position": number or null, "sentiment": "positive" or "neutral" or "negative" or null, "competitors_mentioned": ["name", ...]}, "key_quote": "the single most useful sentence from any answer for a sales pitch"}. position means where the audited business appears in any recommended list (1 = recommended first), null if not mentioned. competitors_mentioned means other business names recommended instead of the audited business.') }}}] }

nodes.name: Analyse Mentions
nodes.notes: CREDENTIAL NEEDED: same Anthropic Header Auth credential as Ask Claude. Analyses all 3 answers per question and returns structured JSON.

nodes.name: Aggregate Results
nodes.notes: Computes the visibility scores. No changes needed. Skim its output before sending a report to a paying client.

parameters.jsonBody:
={ "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6", "max_tokens": 4000, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": {{ JSON.stringify('You are generating a client-facing AI Visibility Audit report for Baron AI Solutions LTD, a UK agency. Audience: a small business owner with no technical knowledge. Tone: clear, professional, no jargon, no hype.

Produce a COMPLETE standalone HTML document (inline CSS only, clean modern design, dark navy and white palette, works in an email client). Return ONLY the HTML, no markdown fences, no commentary.

Structure: 1) Header with report title, business name, town, audit date, and Baron AI Solutions branding text. 2) Headline scorecard: visibility rate on each of the three AI engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) as big percentages with a one-line plain-English verdict. 3) What this means: 3-4 sentences explaining that customers now ask AI tools who to hire and this report shows how often the business is recommended. 4) Competitors AI recommends instead: table of top competitors with mention counts. 5) Question-by-question results: a table with the question asked, whether the business was mentioned on each engine (tick/cross), and sentiment. 6) Key finding: use the most damaging or most useful key_quote from the data. 7) Recommended next steps: 4-5 bullet actions (website answer-readiness, schema markup, review generation, third-party citations, consistent listings) framed as what Baron AI Solutions would do in a monthly programme. 8) Footer: Baron AI Solutions LTD contact placeholder and a disclaimer that AI answers vary over time and by user, and no agency can guarantee specific AI recommendations.

Audit data (JSON): ' + JSON.stringify($json)) }}}] }

nodes.name: Generate HTML Report
nodes.notes: CREDENTIAL NEEDED: same Anthropic Header Auth credential. EDIT THE PROMPT: replace 'Baron AI Solutions LTD contact placeholder' with your real email/phone/website, and adjust the colour palette line to your brand.

nodes.name: Send Report
